headline: Theo Network thBill: RWA treasury token on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana; core contracts identified from docs and GitHub; partial deployment list recovered from documentation fragments

findings.text: D1: Block explorer search for 'thBILL' and 'Theo Network' recovered primary token address 0x5fa487bca6158c64046b2813623e20755091da0b on Ethereum from Etherscan token tracker; further per-chain searches not completed due to tool constraints

D2: Official deployments doc referenced in documentation search results at https://docs.theo.xyz/technical-reference/deployments but fetch failed; deployment addresses found in search result snippet from cached version included ETH Vault, USDC Vault, VaultKeeper across multiple chains

D3: Audit repository located at https://github.com/theo-network/theo-audits containing audit.md and audit_2.md; audit.md covers Stream Finance security review by deadrosesxyz with findings on vault contracts

D4: GitHub organization theo-network identified with repositories including theo-audits (audit records), Theo-Adapter-V2, Theo-Adapter-V3, and hyperliquid-rust-sdk; no deployment JSON files found in accessible repo structure

D5: Protocol stated to operate on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana per search results; Avalanche also mentioned in one source; address enumeration incomplete across chains due to fetch failures for docs and block explorers
D6: No factory contracts identified in available sources; D6 not applicable at current discovery stage
D7: Identified role types: token (thBILL token contract), vault (ETH Vault, USDC Vault), multisig (3/5 cold wallet, 2/4 emergency pause), governance/custody (Standard Chartered Bank custodian role)

D8: Addresses 0x5fa487bca6158c64046b2813623e20755091da0b traced to Etherscan token page; vault addresses from documentation snippet (0x18e0C17bbbdf792925C2Af863570e0e6709DCdB0, 0xd912325C960F1A6276F1E905d2f7715bD3d5C06d, 0x804bae630893383815159e8ca069c398b3f0438a, 0xf677A02A91622E2a3ff5923c6530D383C29b0983, 0x83C6aC60Cfb20a0dF00705A78263B88878EC19b4, 0x7Ca71EE7bEc5ff9DA6a41e86467f6bD56c4E8225, 0x4fE17dEFc597cC3bD6fBe16135d8Ac42D421907e) require on-chain verification

rationale.verdict: Discovery assessment. Protocol is a cross-chain RWA tokenization platform for U.S. Treasury bills (thBILL) and other real-world assets. Primary Ethereum token address recovered from block explorer. Vault and administrative contract addresses identified from documentation fragments but not yet on-chain verified. GitHub audit repository found. Full address enumeration incomplete due to inaccessibility of docs.theo.xyz and app.theo.xyz redirect; block explorer fetches also encountered access restrictions. Downstream slices should prioritize on-chain verification of vault addresses and resolution of multisig/governance addresses across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Solana chains.

evidence.shows: thBILL token (0x5fa487bca6158c64046b2813623e20755091da0b) overview page showing it is 'Theo Short Duration US Treasury Fund' token, provides institutional-grade U.S. Treasury bill exposure
Official Theo website confirming thBILL as AAA-rated U.S. Treasury exposure, thGOLD yield-bearing gold token, and thUSD stablecoin; products are institutional-grade financial products on-chain
GitHub organization theo-network with repositories including theo-audits (audit records for smart contracts), hyperliquid-rust-sdk, and DefiLlama adapter forks
theo-audits repository containing audit.md and audit_2.md documenting security reviews of Theo smart contracts
Stream Finance security audit by deadrosesxyz covering StreamVault.sol, ShareMath.sol, and Vault.sol with findings on vault inflation attacks and keeper centralization risks

unknowns: D1-offchain: Etherscan and per-chain block explorer pages (arbiscan.io, solana explorer) returned access restrictions; unable to complete name-tag search for Theo Network across all three pinned chains

D2-offchain: Official deployments documentation at https://docs.theo.xyz/technical-reference/deployments is not accessible; deployment addresses recovered from cached search result snippet only (0x18e0C17bbbdf792925C2Af863570e0e6709DCdB0, 0xd912325C960F1A6276F1E905d2f7715bD3d5C06d, 0x804bae630893383815159e8ca069c398b3f0438a, 0xf677A02A91622E2a3ff5923c6530D383C29b0983, 0x83C6aC60Cfb20a0dF00705A78263B88878EC19b4, 0x7Ca71EE7bEc5ff9DA6a41e86467f6bD56c4E8225, 0x4fE17dEFc597cC3bD6fBe16135d8Ac42D421907e) without chain assignment or role confirmation
D3: Audit files in theo-audits repository appear to be for Stream Finance vault contracts, not core Theo Network thBILL contracts; actual Theo thBILL audit location uncertain
D4-offchain: GitHub source code repositories not identified; theo-network org contains only adapter forks and utility repos, no core contract source visible
D5: Solana deployment addresses not identified; protocol.chains lists Solana but Solana explorer not accessible and no SPL token address recovered
D5: Avalanche deployment mentioned in one source but not in pinned protocol.chains list; chain assignment ambiguous
D6: No factory contracts identified; protocol architecture does not appear factory-pattern based per available sources
D8: Vault addresses from documentation snippet lack chain IDs and role clarification; require on-chain read API verification once accessible

protocol_metadata.about: Theo Network is an institutional-grade RWA (real-world assets) tokenization platform offering thBILL (U.S. Treasury bill exposure), thGOLD (yield-bearing gold), and thUSD (gold-backed stablecoin). The platform operates across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Solana with LayerZero cross-chain bridging, providing institutional-grade security via 3/5 multisig, 2/4 emergency pause, and custodian services from Standard Chartered Bank regulated by Singapore's MAS.
